anti_circularity: All gates declared BEFORE the corresponding implementation lands. A gate's criterion text is frozen in this file; later commits may only ADD implementation evidence, never rewrite the criterion of a gate that already has a recorded verdict.

lineage.closure: github.com/error-wtf/SSZ_FULL_CLOSURE branch spectroscopy-real-data-20261004 (V3 no-go bd46255, V4 varying-G4 384700c)

gates.name: spectral operator exported
gates.criterion: A machine-readable QNM-operator export exists (potential V, first-derivative matrices, metric fields, law parameters), hash-bound to a declared SSZ_FULL_CLOSURE branch commit, produced by a registered producer tool, with an independent re-derivation check that the exported operator satisfies the declared wave equation on random probe fields.

gates.name: physical BC closed
gates.criterion: Ingoing-wave (or mathematically equivalent) boundary conditions are implemented and VERIFIED against an analytic reference problem whose exact spectrum is known, on the same discretization; the verification must show exponential or small-algebraic convergence to the reference eigenvalues.

gates.name: independent eigensolvers agree
gates.criterion: Two structurally different solvers (shooting vs spectral collocation / continued fraction) on identical exported operators agree in complex omega to a frozen tolerance, and the agreement is demonstrated on an analytic control problem first.

gates.name: mode convergence
gates.criterion: Each catalogued mode carries a measured grid-convergence order and a residual epsilon below the frozen per-mode tolerance.

gates.name: Schwarzschild/Kerr control
gates.criterion: The pipeline, run unmodified on the Schwarzschild axial Regge-Wheeler potential, reproduces published high-precision QNM values (l=2 n=0: omega = 0.3736723 - 0.0889623i within 1e-4). This gate is a HARD prerequisite for any SSZ mode claim.

gates.name: certified mode catalogue
gates.criterion: A frozen catalogue exists whose every row is a certified tuple (l, m, n, omega, eps_residual, eps_convergence, eps_solver, branch) per the MODE-C1..C8 certification contract in docs/MODE_CERTIFICATION_CONTRACT.md; rows failing any C-gate are listed with their failing gate, never silently dropped.

gates.name: time-domain waveform
gates.criterion: A time-domain ringdown waveform h(t) is produced from a certified mode set through the exported operator (inverse problem in time or Green-function reconstruction), with a measured waveform-level cross-check against the frequency-domain modes.

gates.name: frequency/phase-domain equivalence
gates.criterion: The eikonal phase transport of the closure (Xi -> D -> g -> Phi) and the spectral phase accumulation omega*t give a measured, tolerance-bounded consistent phase observable on the same branch.

gates.name: synthetic blind recovery
gates.criterion: Hidden SSZ parameters -> synthetic spectrum + realistic noise -> parameter forgetting -> inversion -> truth recovered within declared uncertainties; the hidden values are generated by a separate process and hash-committed before the fit runs.

gates.name: wrong-model negative control
gates.criterion: GR-injected data must NOT make the SSZ model win (Bayes factor below the declared threshold); noise-only data must NOT make either model claim a detection; both controls are measured with the same likelihood that G182 uses.

gates.name: detector-response closure
gates.criterion: The full chain g_SSZ -> L -> omega_n -> h_SSZ(t) -> detector response -> d(t) is executed end-to-end on synthetic data with a declared detector transfer function.

gates.name: real public data provenance
gates.criterion: Real public strain data (e.g. GWOSC) ingested with SHA-256-locked provenance, documented conditioning, PSD estimation and event window; NO hand-picking of frequencies anywhere in the chain.

gates.name: real-event inference
gates.criterion: p(d|H_SSZ) and p(d|H_GR) evaluated on the same locked data with the same likelihood and declared priors; Bayes factor and posterior predictive checks recorded.

gates.name: GR comparison
gates.criterion: The comparison of G182 is reproduced by an independent implementation path (or frozen re-run) and the model-comparison verdict is stable under declared prior variations.

gates.name: empirical spectroscopy verdict
gates.criterion: The final recorded verdict (A: SSZ supported / B: inconclusive / C: SSZ disfavored) emitted ONLY after G150..G183 all carry recorded verdicts; any open predecessor forces G190 = BLOCKED.

blocked_predecessors.note: B6 (physical BC layer) and B8 (sector coupling) are OPEN in SSZ_FULL_CLOSURE QNM_SPECTROSCOPY_PATH_STATUS_V1.json. G151 deliberately attacks exactly this: the analytic-reference verification is the honest way to close the physical BC layer. G150 is NOT blocked by B6/B8: exporting and independently verifying the operator does not require solved BCs.
